allot.text: Rossell Techsys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 2572898 securities pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on November 04, 2026

allot.text: Rossell Techsys Limited has informed regarding ADDITIONAL INFORMATION IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED PREFERENTIAL ISSUE

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Rossell Techsys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on September 18, 2026, regarding issue of up to 25,72,898 equity shares of the Company to the Proposed Investors (Non-Promoter Category) on a preferential basis, subject to the necessary approvals.
